note: Issue #526: /land, pr-state.sh and the snapshot reader read the provenance record from issue #586 'Provenance record' instead of the Owner dashboard (#43). Only where the record is read changes; the decoder and the admission rules are untouched. SnapshotCli.provenanceIssueOf (was dashboardOf) accepts exactly the title 'Provenance record' and keeps the three other checks (the owner's login, open, no pull_request marker), so 'Owner dashboard' is now refused. Two new snapshot-test cases pin that, one on the snapshot path and one on the native hook; on a mutant that accepts both titles exactly those two fail (268 passed, 2 failed, one run). The env key LAND_DASHBOARD is LAND_PROVENANCE_ISSUE, with the literal 586, changed together in land.yml, LandPins, the placement fixture and workflow-pins-check.py; a new pin mutant checks that a land.yml still naming LAND_DASHBOARD is refused as land.decide. The hook variable MITOS_DASHBOARD is MITOS_PROVENANCE_ISSUE, default 586, and a new pr-state case checks that the retired name selects no issue. Kept on purpose: the read names dashboard.json and dash.json and the 'unread dashboard' key, which are the file interface between the scripts, the tool and the land record, and the In flight reader that #527 owns. Local runs, one each: lake build mitos-gate (697 jobs); snapshot-test 270 passed (main 266); pr-state.test 715 ok (main 714); provenance-transport 43; workflow-pins 280 (main 279); workflow-test and placement (2 land workflows, 52 mutations); all 28 gate/*-test.sh exit 0; land-decide.test 29, land-protection.test 6, land-apply.test 41, land-report.test 20, app-token.test, ci-trust.test, gh-api-rest.test 7, sourced-bash.test 12, the agents-skills check, plan-tasks.test 20, workflow-diff (7 files, 0 differences), imports (0 violations). Concrete run: the head-built mitos-gate provenance candidates on the REST JSON of #586 exits 0, and on #43 exits 1 ('provenance: source or routes refused'); the v2 sections of #586 and #43 were byte-identical (27308 bytes) at that read. A real run of snapshot-fetch.sh on issue 586 and mitos-gate snapshot from this head said 'unread protection, dashboard' for every open PR: the body of #586 has no level-2 heading between its empty In flight table and the section, so the table reader runs into the section. With a heading added there (a local copy of the JSON, section bytes unchanged) only protection is unread, which needs a workflow run. Two new snapshot-test cases pin both shapes. The root, who publishes #586, must add the heading before the merge. elan's toolchain host is refused here, so Lean v4.35.0 came from a linked GitHub release. The post-merge workflow_dispatch run of land and the pr-state read on main are the root's.
